CodeContent:
"# Upgrading Franchise Page Magnifying Glass Task List

- [ ] Create wrapper container `#magnifiable-page` in `FranchisePageClient.tsx`
- [ ] Add state variables (`isMagnifierActive`, `isHoveringClose`, `lensPos`, `pageHtml`, `pageSize`)
- [ ] Implement coordinates updates and page HTML cloning logic in `useEffect` and `mousemove` handler
- [ ] Implement freeze-on-hover physics logic for the lens positioning
- [ ] Rebuild and enlarge the magnifier lens overlay with a close button and remove the "ZOOM" text
- [ ] Create the activation floating button on the page when the magnifier is closed
- [ ] Modify `ImageMagnifier` so that it doesn't double-zoom when global magnifier is active
- [ ] Verify functionality (checking hover behavior, close button clicking, re-activation, styling)
"
